𝗦𝗔𝗤𝗜𝗕 𝗦𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗡-𝗙𝗢𝗥! 🔥

Pakistan debutant Saqib Khan takes 7 as Sri Lanka are all out for 446 in Rawalpindi.
SL lead by 12 after Pakistan's 434/9d; de Silva made 167.

Who wins from here? 👇

#PAKvSL #Cricket
